themes.summary: Sound is crisp and the bass is rich without muddying vocals . Battery lasts all week on a single charge, even with daily calls . Paired with laptop in seconds and switches between devices easily .

themes.summary: Compact footprint fits perfectly on small kitchen counter . Removable filter basket makes cleanup very simple . Reusable filter is easy to rinse and saves money on paper filters .
The carafe leaks a few drops onto the counter every morning . Water tank is small, so I have to refill it for a full pot . Brewing cycle is quite loud early in the morning .
